hints.title: Fixed Length Sliding Window
hints.text: To achieve k consecutive black blocks, find a window of length k with the minimum count of white blocks 'W'.

hints.title: Sliding Count Maintenance
hints.text: Count 'W' in the initial k-length prefix, then slide the window one position right at each step.

hints.title: Minimum Recolors
hints.text: The minimum number of white blocks in any k-length window is the answer.

hints.title: Fixed Window Counter Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-counting white blocks per window takes O(n * k).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains sliding window state in O(1) time per step.
